title: docs(pm-dispatch): review seats take contract reviews first, the lane next, never triage
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBUyArWn6eHL33NNgvdpkwiW)_

Fixes #29242

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 新增复核席章程 `lanes/review.md`(21 行):`review#N` 席位坐在能达 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 的其他账号上,专职契约复审;车道的 `Request: contract-review` 门铃改敲复核席信箱,无复核席在座时敲车道兄弟席;互斥沿用既有 `Contract-review-claim:` 行,同 head 先贴者持有;复核席不复核本账号派发或实现的 PR,不 merge、不 ready、不派发、不定级。`contract-review.md`(60/60)、`project-forms.md`(59/59)、`lanes/triage.md`(20/20)、`SKILL.md` 车道表(319/319)各在上限内改词指向它。脚本侧:`review` 成为可签名、可开信箱的席位词;`check-owed-reviews.mjs` 先点名复核席(坐在本 PR 派发或实现账号上的复核席回避,不点名),车道只在无复核席可接或多等一轮无认领后接;`fleet-roster.mjs` 把复核席列成行,在办 = 其活认领持有的 PR。
- **为什么改:** 您的原话「契约复审我想分拆到其他账户,怎么处理。」与裁定「选 B,立卡」。此前所有契约复审都在分诊一个账号一个会话上跑,写预算和模型额度互相挤占。
- **风险与回滚:** 文本三处零增行、不抬上限,新文件一行新棘轮行(21);脚本改动全是纯函数加自测,不加门禁、不加标签、不加信箱键。回滚 = revert 本 PR;已坐席的复核席只需撤座位贴。
- **先看:** ① `lanes/review.md` 全文;② `contract-review.md` 第 5、23 行(复核席先接,车道次之,⛔ 非分诊);③ `check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的 `takerOf` / `reviewSeatsOf`;④ `fleet-roster.mjs` 的 `reviewClaims`。
- **两分钟验证:** `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`(预期 `84 cases pass in 10 batteries`)、`node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --fixture scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json --now 2026-10-23T14:00:00Z`(表中出现 `review` 行,在办 `objectstack#25433`)、`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`。
- **需要你做的:** 一处与卡面不同,请知悉(见下 Deviations):回退席不是分诊而是车道兄弟席,依据您 11-03 的话「目前各车道都有fable,应该不需要你契约复审」。无其他动作;席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**New `references/lanes/review.md` (21 lines, new ratchet row at 21, every line ≤ 120 bytes).** The card's points 1–6 only, pointing at `contract-review.md` for the review itself: the seat (`review#N`, `review#1` first, one seat post each, any account that reaches `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; session effort `high`, review subagents at the review tier, a declaration-face-only review at `TIER_DEFAULT`; one `pm:mailbox` PR per seat through `mailbox-open.mjs --seat review#N`); the routing (lanes ring `Request: contract-review` at any review seat's mailbox, a free one takes it; with none seated the bell goes to a sibling lane seat, ⛔ never triage; mutual exclusion is the existing `Contract-review-claim:` line, the earlier claim on a head holds, between review seats too, the later withdraws and drops its output; `check-owed-reviews.mjs` names a review seat first and the lane only when none is seated or a further round after (b) passed with no claim; the delta re-review stays with the original reviewer, and a review seat off duty with a stale record hands the delta to the next review seat, named in the hand-off line); independence and bounds (⛔ never a PR its own account dispatched or implemented, records keep `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:`; ⛔ no merge, ready, dispatch, grading or human-floor action; security findings per `security-findings.md`).

**`references/contract-review.md` (60/60, net 0 lines, no raise).** The 〈复核归属与资格〉 heading now points at `lanes/review.md`; line 23 folds the routing into the existing owed-review sentence (「复核席先接,车道次之,⛔ 非分诊」, 119 bytes); the seat word is `复核席` throughout (the older `复审席` spelling retired on four lines). The claim template line and the 2-hour lapse are untouched (pinned by `record-recognisers.mjs`).

**`references/project-forms.md` (59/59, net 0 lines).** The seat-word line names `复核 = review.md` beside 总监 and 分诊 (115 bytes); the `Request: contract-review` row's taker reads `复核席`.

**`references/lanes/triage.md` (20/20, net 0 lines).** Edited only after #29940 merged and `origin/main` was merged into this branch (the serial constraint): the 不推 line now reads 「契约复核(归复核席,`review.md`)」 in place of 「PASS/FAIL 归车道」 (117 bytes), so the triage charter points at the review seat and never calls itself the fallback.

**`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.** One added `CEILINGS` row for the new lane file at its landed count (21, headroom 0) with the card's verbatim ruling quoted in the row comment, and its `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin (0). No existing row moves.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (319/319, net 0 lines; patch round 1, S1).** The lane table's `security` row now reads `security` · `review` and ends 「复核席 `review#N` 见 `references/lanes/review.md`」 (333 bytes, within the 341-byte row pin), so the charter has an entry point from the skill itself; the skills token ratchet stays within its ceiling on the merged head.

**`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`.** `review` joins `SEAT_BARE_LANES` and the signature alternation `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` (the two lists `fleet-roster.mjs` pins equal), so `review#N` can sign a comment, open a mailbox (`mailbox/LOGIN/review-N`) and post a claim; `domain:review` stays refused.

**`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`.** `contractReviewClaims` reads a claim's side off its signature: `triage#N` is the legacy `triage` side (still yields), `review#N` is the `review` side, everything else is `lane`. Between review and lane there is no precedence: the earliest live claim holds, which is what keeps two review seats off one head.

**`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`.** `reviewSeatsOf(seats)` reads the roster for seated review seats; the row carries `reviewSeat` (seated / stood-down / absent / unknown) and `reviewSeats`; `takerOf` names `a review seat (review#1, …) first` while one is seated, adds `or the LANE seat (a further round waited, no claim)` after `LANE_JOINS_AFTER_ROUNDS` (2) × `TRIAGE_ROUND_MINUTES`, and names `the LANE seat (no review seat seated)` while none is. A hand-off still names its seat whatever the roster says. Patch round 1 (S2): `ownAccountsOf(pull)` reads the PR's own accounts — the implementing account from the body's `claude-projects-attribution` login and the dispatching account from the signer of each `Claim:` comment on the delivered card — and `reviewSeatsOf` bars a review seat seated on either (`lanes/review.md` 独立性); a barred seat is never named, and when every seated review seat is barred the state is `barred` and the lane's own seat takes at once, no further round. The printed row shows `review seat STATE SEATS (barred SEATS)`. Patch round 2 (S4): when the delivered card's comments could not be read, `ownAccountsOf` returns null and the state is `unjudged` — the seated review seats are named only with the caveat 「unless on this PR's own account (card comments unread)」, the lane's own seat beside them, so no seat the rule may bar is printed as free.

**`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` and its fixture.** A `review` seat post is a row like the lanes; its in-flight is `reviewClaims`: the open pulls whose CURRENT head a live `Contract-review-claim:` signed `review#N` holds, read off the signed-comment read the roster already makes (the claim lapses in 2 h, the read starts `STALE_HOURS` = 6 h back). Review rows never share (`= seat N`) and hold no card. The fixture gains a review seat post, its mailbox pull, head shas on two pulls and three review-signed claims (one live, one expired, one on a moved head); the rendered roster shows `| objectstack | review | 1 | 🟢 os-zhuang | objectstack#25433 | … |`.

**Not added:** no gate, no label, no mailbox key (the existing `Request: contract-review` key carries the routing), no ceiling raise, no changeset (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing).

## Deviations from the card, declared

The card's rule 2 and 3 and its acceptance line say triage is the fallback reviewer (「With no review seat seated, the bell goes to triage, as today」, 「falls back to triage」), and `lanes/triage.md` was to read 「triage becomes the fallback reviewer」. This PR builds the fallback as the lane's own seat (a sibling lane seat), never triage, for two reasons: (1) `origin/main` already says so — `contract-review.md` 「车道或复审席接,⛔ 非分诊」, `triage-duties.md` 「⛔ 分诊不再审」, and `check-owed-reviews.mjs`' taker never named triage at the branch point — so building triage back in would reverse a landed rule; (2) the maintainer's later word on 2026-11-03, verbatim: 「目前各车道都有fable,应该不需要你契约复审」. The self-test covers the no-review-seat case as 「the lane's own seat takes」 and pins that the row never names triage. Agreed with the skills seat before building.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` — 84 cases in 10 batteries, new battery `review-seat first …` (16): seated review seat first, the lane joins after a further round, no review seat ⇒ the lane's own seat (the card's acceptance case, never triage), stood-down ≠ seated, lane gone, roster unread, hand-off, a review seat's live claim ⇒ HELD, the printed row; S2: own accounts read from the attribution line and the card claim's signer, the only review seat on the implementing account ⇒ barred and the lane takes at once, a review seat on the dispatching account barred while a third-account seat still takes first, the lane gone with the only seat barred, a seat with no account never barred; S4: an unread card thread ⇒ `unjudged` with the caveat, a readable empty thread or no card still judges the bar.
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` — 110 cases in 9 batteries: the review row (lane, seat, account, in-flight = the live claim's pull, mailbox, last activity), only the live claim on the current head counts of three, a lane-signed or unsigned claim is nothing, the lane-word pin against `SEAT_BARE_LANES`, the rendered row.
- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` — 366 cases: review side holds when first, lane first ⇒ lane holds, two review seats ⇒ earliest holds.
- `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` — 83 cases in 10 batteries (`review#2` opens `review-2`; `domain:review#1` refused); S3 fixed the 「The same three / four words」 comment above `SEAT_LANE_KINDS`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` — 5222 cases on the merged head (the `review` alternation beside main's H74).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — review.md 21/21, contract-review.md 60/60, project-forms.md 59/59, triage.md 20/20, SKILL.md 319/319 (widest row 341, pin 341), widest prose line ≤ 120 bytes; `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — exit 0 (that ratchet walks `skills/` only, so `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is outside it; the binding gates on SKILL.md are the line ratchet and the row pin); `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` clean; `npx eslint` on the edited scripts exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `lanes/review.md` exists with points 1–6; `contract-review.md` (heading and line 23), `project-forms.md` (seat-word line) and `lanes/triage.md` (the 不推 line) point at it.
- `check-owed-reviews.mjs` prints the review-seat-first routing; its self-test covers no review seat seated (⇒ the lane's own seat, see Deviations).
- `fleet-roster.mjs` lists review seats, in-flight = claimed heads.
- Line budget: contract-review.md 60/60 · project-forms.md 59/59 · lanes/triage.md 20/20 · lanes/review.md 21/21 (new row) · SKILL.md 319/319. No raise.
- `Writes:` `git push` ×4 (WIP head 618cdf4f, review head 9da0cd8c, patch round 1 head 6e66dd44, patch round 2 head f850ac1b), relay `pr_create` ×1 (draft, `labels: ["skip-changeset"]`, no assignees), `post-stamped.mjs --comment` ×1 for the `os-dev-report`. `mcp_calls`: GitHub MCP reads only (`issue_read`, `pull_request_read`); no MCP write.

## Verification

- Patch round 2 (check-owed-reviews.mjs only) re-ran its self-test (84 cases), fleet-roster's (110) and `npx eslint` on `f850ac1b` — exit 0. Patch round 1 (SKILL.md, check-owed-reviews.mjs, mailbox-open.mjs) re-ran the gates that diff can move on `6e66dd44`: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:pm-half-states`, the self-tests of check-owed-reviews (82), fleet-roster (110), record-recognisers (366), mailbox-open (83) and `npx eslint` on the two scripts — all exit 0.

Repeat the two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` → `✓ check-owed-reviews self-test: 84 cases pass in 10 batteries`; `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --fixture scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json --now 2026-10-23T14:00:00Z` → a `review` row with `objectstack#25433` in flight.
